title: Saudi-Style Sausage Skewers
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish from the Middle East, featuring juicy sausages grilled to perfection on skewers.

ingredients.name: Arabian Zesty Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Soak the skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together Arabian Zesty Spice Mix and lemon juice.
Thread the sausages onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each sausage.
Brush the skewers with the spice and lemon mixture.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the sausages are cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
